# Git Hook Managers — Benchmark 2026

## Comparative Matrix

| Dimensión | Lefthook | pre-commit | Husky v9+ | pre-commit-golang | Custom Go (OVAV) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Lenguaje** | Go 86% | Python 97% | JS/Shell | Python (envuelve Go) | Go 100% |
| **Binario** | Single binary (~12MB) | pip/zipapp | tiny shell shim | No binario propio | Binary nativo |
| **Dependencias** | **Cero** | Python + pip | Node.js | Python + pre-commit | **Cero** |
| **Linux** | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |

| **Windows** | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| **Config** | lefthook.yml (YAML) | .pre-commit-config.yaml | .husky/ scripts | .pre-commit-hooks.yaml | OVAV CLI subcmd |
| **Paralelismo** | ✅ Nativo | ✅ (--parallel) | ❌ Secuencial | Depende de pre-commit | ✅ Control total |
| **Stars** | ~5k | 15.4k | ~33k | 373 | N/A |

## Go-Native Alternatives Identified

- **evilmartians/lefthook** — Único manager Go maduro con adopción seria.
- **compilerla/conventional-pre-commit** — Go, pero solo verifica commits convencionales.
- **checkmake/checkmake** — Go linter para Makefiles (no hook manager).
- No se encontró ningún otro Go-native hook manager con más de 100 stars.

## Enterprise Patterns (Monorepos Go)

| Proyecto | Enfoque | Herramienta |
|---|---|---|
| Helm | Makefile + golangci-lint | Makefile targets |
| Kubernetes | Custom bash + OWNERS | Scripts en hack/ |
| Terraform | Makefile + go fmt/vet | Makefile + CI |
| Dagger | Engine interno (Go) | Custom en Dagger engine |
| Earthly | Earthfile + CI | Earthfile targets |

**Patrón observado:** Los grandes monorepos Go evitan managers externos. Usan Makefile targets + CI gates. Los hooks locales son bash delgados que llaman al CLI o Makefile.
